label: LuaRocks
note: Requires Lua 5.5 and Titan 0.6 (tested on 0.6.1). Installs mk.so and mk.a (mk.dll on Windows) into Titan's module path; luarocks show --rock-dir titan-mk locates the bundled manual and coding-agent skill.

label: Static Link

steps.label: System-OpenSSL SDK (Linux & macOS)
steps.commands:
TITAN_EXTRA_CPPFLAGS="$(pkg-config --cflags openssl)" \
TITAN_EXTRA_LDFLAGS="$(pkg-config --libs openssl)" \
  titanc --static --tree src -o build --exe build/my-service service.main

note: mk imports titan.http and titan.websocket (backed by titan.ssl). Static linking is supported on Linux and macOS.
